details.name: Calculating the Sum of the Values in the List
details.description: Construct a program that has a function that receives a list and calculates the sum of the values in that list.

details.name: Calculating the Average of the Values in the List
details.description: Construct a program that has a function that receives a list and calculates the average of the values in that list. The program should handle lists with arbitrary number of values (including an empty list).
